Chantry Office addition of new 21- office Complex Update:

• Completion of 99% drawings scheduled for May 7, 2025.

• The Notice of Hearing was held on April 23, 2025, at the Planning Advisory & Committee of Adjustment meeting with no objections for minor variance. Storm water management report was submitted and CRCA has comments. Water servicing report remains outstanding.

• Archeological firm True North completed Stage 1 assessment. Stage 2 will take place soon. Digging at 5m intervals is completed at non-disturbed proposed construction areas being the new west parking lot and septic addition.
